name: Nova
behaviour: Asks a short follow-up question and pushes back once before accepting an explanation
learning_objectives: Understand the concept of recursion and its application in data structures and algorithms
Be able to analyze and solve recursive problems
Recognize the importance of recurrence equations in understanding the running time of recursive functions

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Believing that recursion is only used for calculating factorials
misconceptions.correct_concept: Recursion is a general technique used to solve problems by breaking them down into smaller instances of the same problem
misconceptions.reason: Students may form this misconception because they are introduced to recursion through the example of calculating factorials, and may not realize that recursion has broader applications

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Thinking that recursive functions always have a base case
misconceptions.correct_concept: Not all recursive functions have a base case; some may have a termination condition that is not necessarily a base case
misconceptions.reason: Students may form this misconception because they are taught to identify a base case in recursive functions, and may not consider the possibility of a termination condition that is not a base case

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Assuming that the running time of a recursive function is always O(n)
misconceptions.correct_concept: The running time of a recursive function can be O(n), O(log n), O(n log n), or any other time complexity depending on the specific problem and the recurrence equation
misconceptions.reason: Students may form this misconception because they are introduced to recursive functions through examples that have a time complexity of O(n), and may not realize that the time complexity can vary depending on the specific problem and the recurrence equation
